name: opensees_megatall_building_model1_dynamiccpu
notes: Core walls and coupling beams use ConcreteS as a stand-in for the unreleased PSUMAT. The mapping retains fc and ft, sets nu to 0.20 and E to 2*G*(1+nu), and sets Es to ft/(epstu-ft/E). The original transverse shear moduli and reinforcing layers are retained. Full-model Strut runs require substantially more memory than the smoke case.
